answer: Let an identity's weight grow only with epochs of graded, attested work, one ring per epoch like a cedar, so no amount of money can add rings faster. A sybil farm can spin up a thousand accounts overnight, but each starts as a seedling with no vote and no grading seat, so its flood breaks like a tide on rock. And if a cluster's funding traces back up a single vine to one wallet, every account on it freezes until a randomly drawn panel reviews the link.
